segments.title: Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on and identifies himself as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Sick Day Setup
segments.notes: Case Blackwell explains he is ill after a Disney trip, voice strained, and will play Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC instead of a standard news broadcast.

segments.title: Mohg, Lord of Blood Fight
segments.notes: Case summons 'Strong' (Sporophyte) and defeats Mohg after multiple attempts, using rot breath and dragon attacks to access the DLC.

segments.title: Realm of Shadow Entry & Early Exploration
segments.notes: Case touches Miquella's withered arm, enters the Realm of Shadow, discovers Scadutree Fragment leveling system, and meets NPCs Hornsent, Moore, and the Kindly Pot Boy.

segments.title: Kendelle Walk-By
segments.notes: Kendelle calls Case on camera, says goodbye to chat, and departs.

segments.title: Deep Shadow Exploration & Fire Knight Fight
segments.notes: Case navigates sewers, piss rivers, and castle ruins; defeats Fire Knight Queelign with rot and frenzy; collects smithing stones and lore items.

segments.title: Divine Beast Dancing Lion Boss Fight
segments.notes: Case summons NPC Freya and after many attempts defeats the Divine Beast Dancing Lion using rot, frenzy, and blood loss.

segments.title: Post-Boss Lore & Armor Reveal
segments.notes: Case reads the Divine Beast Head item description: ritual headwear of the sculpted keepers that boosts storm intensity, strength, and dexterity but reduces flask healing and focus.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case ends stream, raids Danksauce, and attributes illness to 'the curse of Disney.'

lore_notes.fact: Case contracted illness at Disney, describes it as 'the curse of Disney'
Case's voice strained from illness, limits vocal range for characters
Shadow of the Erdtree DLC released June 20, 2024 at 3 PM PDT (Case was unaware)
Case defeats Mohg, Lord of Blood with summon 'Strong' (Sporophyte) to access DLC
Enters Realm of Shadow via Miquella's withered arm at Mohg's corpse
Discovers Scadutree Fragment system: DLC-exclusive leveling via fragments at Sites of Grace
Meets NPC Hornsent, former servant of Mohg now investigating Miquella's purpose
Meets NPC Moore (forager brood) and Kindly Pot Boy in ruins
Fights and defeats Fire Knight Queelign in castle ruins
Defeats Divine Beast Dancing Lion boss with NPC summon Freya
Acquires Divine Beast Head: ritual lion dance headwear of sculpted keepers, boosts storm/strength/dexterity, reduces flask healing and focus

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell hosts a solo 'Elden Sick Day' broadcast from the newsroom, playing the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC on its surprise release day while recovering from a Disney-acquired illness. After defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood to access the Realm of Shadow, Case explores the new territory, discovers the Scadutree Fragment progression system, and overcomes the Divine Beast Dancing Lion boss to claim its ritual headwear. The broadcast concludes with a raid to Danksauce.
